title: ASHISH KAMAL SARAF VS. AANCHAL ASHISH SARAF

paras.text:
1
ITEM NO.1623 COURT NO.16 SECTION XVI-A
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS
Transfer Petition(s)(Civil) No(s). 3189/2026
ASHISH KAMAL SARAF Petitioner(s)
 VERSUS
AANCHAL ASHISH SARAF Respondent(s)
IA No. 323815/2026 - PERMISSION TO FILE ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTS/
FACTS/ANNEXURES and IA No. 322075/2026 - STAY APPLICATION
Date : 16-10-2026 This matter was called on for hearing today.
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEVENDRA KUMAR UPADHYAYA
For Petitioner(s) Ms. Ruchi Kohli, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Rishi Matoliya, AOR
Mr. Nikhil Kumar Singh, Adv.
Mr. Kshitish Bikarmia, Adv.
Mr. Raghuveer Pujari, Adv.
Ms. Sumati Sharma, Adv.

For Respondent(s) Mr. Aditya Singh, AOR
 Mr. Kamal Kishor, Adv.
Mr. Rajiv Dalal, Adv.
Mr. Pankaj Yadav, Adv.
Mr. Anubhav Singh, Adv.
Mr. Vaseem, Adv.
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R
1. Learned counsel for both the parties submitted that there is a
chance of an amicable settlement between the parties.
2. Let the matter be referred to the Supreme Court Mediation
Centre.
3. The parties are directed to appear before the Supreme Court
Mediation Centre virtually on the first hearing which is fixed on
27.10.2026 before the Mediator for initiation of mediation
proceedings. In case the nominated learned mediator requires the

2
physical presence of the parties then the parties may appear
physically or as decided by the learned mediator.
4. Let the matter be listed for further proceedings after
completion of the mediation proceedings along with Mediation
Report.
5. In the meantime, there shall be stay of further proceedings in
the case bearing HMA No. 895/2025 titled as "Dr. Aanchal Ashish
Saraf vs. Ashish Kamal Saraf" pending before the District and
Sessions Judge, Chandigarh and Complaint D.V. Act 304/2025 [CNR No.
CHCH03046813205] pending before Judicial Magistrare, 1st Class,
Chandigarh.
(KANCHAN CHOUHAN) (PARVEEN KUMAR RAWAT)
SENIOR PERSONAL ASSISTANT COURT MASTER (NSH)
